description: This Kotlin source file defines the ProgressChartPresenter class, which renders a mini bar chart visualizing calorie intake over the last 7 days on an Android TV app. It creates custom views with styled bars and labels, utilizing Android graphics APIs and external resources such as colors and models.

classes.name: ProgressChartPresenter
classes.description: A presenter class responsible for rendering a small bar chart of weekly calorie data with TV-friendly styling.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and configures an ImageCardView to display the progress chart.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Converts a list of ProgressEntry objects into a bitmap with styled bars and labels, then sets it as the card's image.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Cleans up resources by removing the image bitmap when the view holder is unbound.
